profile.headline: Senior / Staff Embedded Software Engineer | C | ARM Systems | RTOS | Embedded Linux | Low-Level Systems & Architecture
profile.summary:
I’m an accomplished and solutions-driven professional with extensive experience designing, developing, and optimizing high-performance C/C++ systems across embedded, automotive, and mobile platforms. I enjoy working close to the hardware while building reliable, scalable software solutions that perform in real-world, high-demand environments.
I’ve contributed to production-grade software deployed with major global automotive OEMs, including Toyota, Honda, Nissan, Audi, and Volkswagen, as well as consumer devices exceeding 5M+ units shipped. My work focuses on delivering robust engineering solutions that meet strict performance, safety, and reliability requirements at scale.
My core expertise includes system architecture, multithreaded programming, concurrency control, and performance optimization, particularly within ARM-based and resource-constrained environments. I also have strong experience in cross-platform SDK development across Linux, Windows, and macOS, along with low-level system integration, firmware, and embedded middleware development.
I take ownership of the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through implementation, testing, validation, and production support. I also design scalable APIs and SDK frameworks, including offline data processing and low-latency systems for bandwidth-constrained automotive environments, with a strong focus on quality, efficiency, and reliability. Let’s connect!

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led architecture and development of embedded SDKs for automotive infotainment systems, delivering high-performance, cross-platform C/C++ solutions across Linux, Windows, macOS, and ARM environments.

Designed scalable system architecture and APIs for real-time audio and metadata processing, leveraging multithreading and concurrency control to meet strict performance and reliability requirements in production automotive systems.

Drove cross-functional collaboration with global engineering teams, including close partnership with Japan-based stakeholders, to align requirements, support system integration, and ensure successful delivery across multiple OEM programs.

Introduced offline local lookup capability within Gracenote’s GNSDK, enabling music recognition without network connectivity. This solution was deployed across multiple vehicle platforms and remains in active production use.

Improved system stability and performance by diagnosing and resolving complex low-level issues involving memory, timing, and concurrency. Established automated testing frameworks using GoogleTest and CI pipelines, strengthening software quality and reducing defect rates.
positions.insights: C (Programming Language), Test Driven Development and +16 skills

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led development and integration of embedded SDK components for automotive infotainment systems, focusing on high-performance C/C++ modules across Linux and ARM-based platforms.

Implemented multithreaded systems for real-time audio and metadata processing, addressing complex issues related to concurrency, memory management, and system timing in production environments.

Collaborated with cross-functional and international teams to support system design, integration, and issue resolution across multiple OEM programs.

Played a key role in enhancing system reliability by debugging and resolving critical defects in live deployments, improving overall platform stability and performance.

Contributed to the evolution of internal testing practices, supporting the adoption of automated testing and continuous integration workflows.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed embedded C/C++ software components for automotive and multimedia SDKs, supporting cross-platform environments including Linux and ARM-based systems.

Implemented core functionality for real-time audio and metadata processing, contributing to high-performance, production-grade software deployed across global automotive OEM platforms.

Debugged and resolved low-level issues involving memory, logs, and system behavior, ensuring reliable operation in resource-constrained embedded environments.

Worked closely with engineering teams to support integration, testing, and delivery of software components across multiple product releases.
positions.insights: Test Driven Development, C++ and +11 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Design Engineer, Differentiating software, Imaging
positions.description:
As a lead software design engineer, I led development of multimedia subsystems for early smartphone platforms, supporting small engineering groups delivering video and computer vision capabilities. 

I implemented and optimized low-level C modules for ARM-based processors operating under tight real-time and memory constraints. I also developed validation strategies and automated testing tools for media pipelines, while defining APIs and system architecture linking application, middleware, and hardware layers. In addition, I collaborated with algorithm, firmware, and integration teams to ensure smooth cross-layer delivery.

I managed a 5-engineer team at Nokia Tokyo R&D, driving Symbian codec integration within a sub-one-year schedule and enabling VGA 30fps MP4 recording/playback on the Nokia N93, shipped in 5M+ units worldwide. I also introduced a reusable interface framework that streamlined integration and improved coordination across development teams.
